source_limit: French rapid/unplanned/no-rereading and conscious-contribution instructions corroborate essential Seaver/Lane1969 transcription facts. Not a full textual collation or manuscript authentication. French excerpt omits the concentration-setting clause and later continuation/arbitrary-letter restart passage; these are not frozen French-subset rules.
historical_restart: Seaver/Lane online transcription describes an arbitrary-letter restart; only a qualified external reference, not required or verified against French original in this profile.
editorial_conventions: All session states/events, optional timestamps/constraints, interruption/restart controls, draft assembly, revisions, metrics and review questions are application conventions.
Stop, pause or omit participation freely; no fixed historical duration, mental-state compliance score or mandatory restart technique.
Revision is a separately labeled creative extension; does not retroactively change the first draft or claim fidelity to a historical first-and-last-draft ideal.

schema.event: Unique plain id,type,optional timestamp/comment. append requires segment;revise requires revision;all other payload combinations reject.
schema.segment: Unique id,strictly increasing integer order,raw text,authorship:user,optional timestamp/elapsed_seconds. Input order preserved;never sorted.
schema.revision: Unique id,parent,independent raw text,authorship:user,optional comment. Linear append-only chain: first_draft then immediately preceding revision ID.
schema.review: optional(default),required(review before completion),no_review(review prohibited);no events after completion
schema.timestamps: ISO date or datetime seconds with optional fraction/offset. Comparable timestamps nondecreasing; naive/aware clocks never implicitly equated. Segment/event timestamps identical if both supplied.
schema.declaration: Events,authorship,state and timing are user declarations;not compliance or mental-state detection. All personal content optional.

first_draft: Exact ordered raw segment text concatenation with empty separator;no hidden spaces,punctuation,Unicode normalization or text replacement. Active/paused drafts may remain unfinished.
revision_isolation: Each revision stores independent text,explicit parent and parent/content hash. Original segments and draft never changed by revisions. No cross-file tamper protection or database; retain replay records.

metrics.characters: Python Unicode code points; no normalization or grapheme counting
metrics.words: Maximal nonempty runs separated by Python str.isspace Unicode whitespace; punctuation/emoji remain in tokens
metrics.lines: Empty text0; otherwise1 plus CRLF/CR/LF delimiters; CRLF is one delimiter, final empty line counted
metrics.duration: Begin-to-stop declared compatible datetime endpoints only; includes pauses; exact integer microseconds authoritative, seconds is a floating display; no inferred active typing time
metrics.segment_intervals: Sum only when every segment declares an integer interval; not inferred or equated to wall duration

evidence_matrix.editorial: Session controls,restart/review/revision conventions,metrics,hashes and neutral questions
evidence_matrix.unsupported: Spirit contact,supernatural/unconscious authorship,trance,diagnosis,hidden memories,future prediction or proof of historical compliance

replay.input: Full validated request,including raw Unicode and omissions
replay.hashes: SHA256 of canonical UTF8 sorted-key compact JSON,unescaped Unicode,no terminal LF. Raw text line endings are content and remain distinct;JSON formatting line endings are portable.
replay.content: Original segment record hashes,draft hash including ordered records,linked revision parent/content hashes and event hashes;not authentication
replay.engine_hash_convention: UTF8 source with universal-newline decoding to LF; portable across Git checkout line endings

verification.assurance: Bounded source fidelity and independent synthetic session/metric known answers,not extraordinary-authorship,mental-state or empirical validation.
